findings.finding: Current company-profile metadata explicitly identifies New York as Graphika's headquarters locality.
Graphika's first-party contact page lists 1230 Avenue of the Americas, Studio, 16th Floor as its New York office but does not designate it headquarters.
USAspending and SBIR records corroborate 1230 Avenue of the Americas as a Graphika/Octant federal recipient or business address, not as an explicit headquarters designation.
A secondary Craft directory calls 1230 Avenue of the Americas 18th Floor the HQ, conflicting at floor level with the first-party 16th-floor office listing.
The post-location August 18 current-news sweep found no material Graphika development newer than the July 30 first-party research/report surface worth ingesting.
